Smt. Krishna vs State Of U.P. on 12 November, 2024
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:177295
Court No

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 39371 of 2024
Applicant :- Smt. Krishna

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Atul Kumar Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Sri Mukesh Joshi, Advocate filed his power on behalf of the informant which is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Rajesh Kumar Yadav Advocate holding brief of Sri Atul Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant; Sri Munish Joshi, learned counsel for the informant and Dr. S. B. Maurya, learned AGA-I for the State-respondent.

3. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
0319 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Katghar, District Moradabad, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is mother in law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, she has been made accused in the present case alongwith other family members including her son i.e. husband of the deceased.

Smt. Krishna vs State Of U.P. on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81753025/
1 5.

He further submitted that applicant resided separately alongwith father in law of the deceased and she was not having any concern with the family affairs of the deceased and the fact the applicant resided separately from the deceased is evident from the ration card of the applicant which has been annexed at page-79 of the paper book.
He next submits, it appears that some dispute arose between husband and wife i.e. deceased and thereafter, his wife i.e. deceased committed suicide by hanging herself.
6. He further submitted that post mortem report of the deceased also suggests that she died due to hanging.
7. He further submitted that applicant is lady and there is no specific allegation against her and she is having no criminal history and she is in jail in the present matter since 4.7.2024.

8. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that daughter in law of the applicant died within four years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but could not dispute the fact that applicant is mother in law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her and post mortem report suggests that deceased died due to hanging.

9. They, however, further submitted that none of the witness in his statement stated that applicant resided separately from the deceased and even from the ration card of the deceased which has been annexed alongwith the instant bail application, it reflects that applicant and deceased both resided in Govind Nagar, area at the time of incident, therefore it cannot be said that applicant resided separately from the deceased.
10.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

11. However, daughter in law of the applicant died within four years of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but applicant is mother in law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her.

12. Further, post mortem report of the deceased suggests that deceased died due to hanging,
therefore, prima facie, it appears to be a case of suicidal death and arguments advanced by learned counsel for the applicant with regard to the alleged suicide committed by the deceased, cannot be ruled out.
13.
Further, applicant is lady and she is having no criminal history and she is in jail in the present matter since 4.7.2024.
14. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances, discussed above, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
15. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

Smt. Krishna vs State Of U.P. on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81753025/
2 16.

Let the applicant-Smt Krishna, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless her personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade her from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
17. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

18. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
